title: Ashbury Rewards Points Transfer Terms Schedule
content:
Ashbury Rewards members may give points to other members. This schedule sets, for every tier, how many points a member may give and receive per calendar year, the transfer increment, the minimum age of each account, and whether a completed transfer can be reversed.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Maximum points given to other members per calendar year | Maximum points received from other members per calendar year | Points are transferred in multiples of | Minimum calendar days since enrolment, sender and recipient alike | Completed transfer can never be reversed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | 100000 | 500000 | 500 | 30 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 100000 | 500000 | 500 | 30 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 100000 | 500000 | 500 | 30 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 100000 | 500000 | 500 | 30 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 100000 | 500000 | 500 | 30 | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 100000 | 500000 | 500 | 30 | Yes |

The terms are identical at all six tiers.

## Basis Q&A

**Is a quantity of 1250 points a valid transfer quantity?** No. Points move in multiples of 500, so 1000 and 1500 are valid quantities and 1250 is not.

**Does the minimum account age apply to the recipient as well?** Yes. The 30 calendar days since enrolment apply to the sender and to the recipient alike.

**Can a completed transfer be undone?** No. At every tier a completed transfer can never be reversed.
